name: OpenQodex
description: Reviews coding-agent changes before you push, using scanners plus a separate Claude Code or Codex reviewer, and gives agents a code-graph MCP server. For developers using coding agents.

skills.name: Change review
skills.description: Reviews unpushed and uncommitted changes, a branch or a pull request, and prints a verdict with findings.

skills.name: Push gate
skills.description: Hooks that check for a passing review before git push, warning by default and blocking at a set severity.

skills.name: Code graph
skills.description: Answers questions about the code, such as who calls a function, through a local MCP server.

skills.name: Dependency advisories
skills.description: Checks every supported lockfile against osv.dev at each review and names fixed versions.

skills.name: GitHub Action
skills.description: Runs the full review on a pull request when given an Anthropic API key, or scanners only without one.
